description: This file defines the 'SugarMerge' class, which manages merging schema and metadata files for modules in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for merging files, handling paths, and creating history logs, facilitating upgrades and customizations.

classes.name: SugarMerge
classes.description: A class that handles merging metadata files for modules, including path management, file merging, and creating history logs to facilitate upgrades and customizations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes path variables and merge mapping for different metadata files.

methods.name: setLogFilePointer
methods.description: Sets the log file pointer for logging merge operations.

methods.name: mergeAll
methods.description: Merges all modules' metadata files that need merging, optionally performing or simulating the merge.

methods.name: mergeModule
methods.description: Merges metadata files for a specific module.

methods.name: mergeFile
methods.description: Merges a single metadata file for a module, optionally saving the result.

methods.name: createHistoryLog
methods.description: Creates a history copy of a custom file before merging, allowing reversion.

methods.name: getCustomPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the custom module directory.

methods.name: getNewPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the new upgrade module directory.

methods.name: getOriginalPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the original module directory.
